process_lessons.lesson: Prefer deleting avoidable overlap/retention over process relocation when exact serial recomputation stays inside timing margin.
Parent-only RSS can reward exported process cost; charge the process tree.
For transparent codec ownership migration, exact compressed-byte and complete-archive identity are stronger early discriminators than cross-decode compatibility.
Test a cdylib ABI through the produced dynamic library; Cargo integration-test extern-C can link the rlib and mislead.
For RSS A/Bs, isolate arms in fresh processes because ru_maxrss is lifetime high-water.
Do not trust a wheel architecture tag as proof of its native binary slices; inspect the installed artifact physically.
